confirmed_design_corrections_before_exec: Backup no longer depends on readable observer state.
Observe no longer scans or depends on unrelated generation inventory/capacity.
Post-observation stability refusal preserves any committed outbox.
Narrow rebind avoids immutable receiver/age/capacity settings while preserving exact history.
Encoded selection size is bounded before publication to match its reader.

official_sources.fact: Already active matching service is not restarted; RemainAfterExit prevents repeated one-shot activation.
One-shot execution requires an explicit startup timeout; recurring failure is not permission for restart storms.
PrivateNetwork namespaces need explicit sharing for related local receiver services.

remaining_boundaries: Trusted local ancestors/current UID; advisory lock is not cross-host fencing.
Same-host automatic selection is not independent/off-host authentication.
No automatic deletion: reviewed capacity can stop captures until manual archival or narrow reviewed rebind.
Source/config/path migration remains separate; rebind changes only reviewed operational policy fields.
Policy/config/source refusal itself needs supervisor/off-host monitoring; it cannot invent a queued observer incident.
Kernel filesystem stalls require native supervisor; cooperative budgets do not preempt them.
Native systemd timers, hard timeout/cgroup cleanup, actual remote channel and sustained operation require separate evidence.

definitions.name: ScheduleRefusal.__init__
definitions.review: Fixed allowlisted codes only; no arbitrary exception/path/configuration text.

definitions.name: _need
definitions.review: Typed fixed refusal boundary.

definitions.name: _hash
definitions.review: Canonical nonzero lowercase64hex pin; booleans/nonstrings rejected.

definitions.name: _sha
definitions.review: SHA256 exact bytes, not semantic or guessed file identity.

definitions.name: _integer
definitions.review: True integers and explicit bounds; bool is excluded.

definitions.name: _absolute
definitions.review: Absolute path, no traversal/UNC/NUL; existing recovery path checks reused.

definitions.name: _separate
definitions.review: Reject equal, nested and ancestor overlap with protected runtime/signer references.

definitions.name: _remaining
definitions.review: Positive floor of one shared absolute cooperative deadline; no per-call reset.

definitions.name: _private_directory
definitions.review: Exact invoking UID0700, protected parent and stable inode; trusted ancestors/UID boundary explicit.

definitions.name: _private_inventory
definitions.review: Exact small allowed file set, private regular nonlinks; required state cannot silently disappear.

definitions.name: _load
definitions.review: External raw policy pin plus exact schema/19 source pins/config raw hash; metadata refs only so missing journal/health remains observable.

definitions.name: _stable
definitions.review: Re-read exact policy/config/source pins before publication and after observation; late uncertainty never rolls back outbox.

definitions.name: _selection
definitions.review: Typed bounded selected record; exact policy/config/deployment binding; generation grammar blocks traversal; no newest-folder fallback.

definitions.name: _observer_state
definitions.review: Require committed valid alert state without creating it; observer history is never automatically reset.

definitions.name: _generation_count
definitions.review: Bounded complete inventory only for capture capacity, counting partial generations; never gates observing the selected backup.

definitions.name: _publish
definitions.review: Size-check before atomic commit; stable old/new policy for rebind; post-rename fsync uncertainty remains preserve-and-review.

definitions.name: _backup
definitions.review: Exclusive new random generation; real exact backup then verify before selection; failure preserves prior selection and retains partial attempt.

definitions.name: _observe
definitions.review: Existing observer handles health/journal incidents and selected-backup verification; no signer/RPC/backup capture or fallback selection.

definitions.name: run_once
definitions.review: Explicit init only; shared process lock; separate backup/observe storage admission; narrow policy-only rebind preserves outbox/pending and capture identity.

definitions.name: SafeArgumentParser.error
definitions.review: Suppress raw invalid argument echo in diagnostics.

definitions.name: main
definitions.review: Explicit action and pin inputs; old-policy flags only rebind; sanitized JSON false readiness, no service installation/signing.
